The handover cites FD-0926, but the approvals log holds FD-0926 only for Evergreen item EOS-1187, a payment of 310.00 GBP gross for 16 October 2026. It does not cover a change to Evergreen's payment details. The log has no approval for this change, and the call-back the handover mentions is not recorded there.
Please confirm whether the FD has approved this bank-detail change under a reference that appears in approvals.json. If the approval exists, send the reference and I will check it again. The FD is out from 2pm today, so the approval needs to be recorded before then if the 3 October master change is to run.
